review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR) and the engine image (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE); the report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in ammo-declarations.json. MEASURED (addresses, record names and counts only; provenance static, never verified_original): the weapons.zrd record parser (0x5ad630) reads AMMO_LIMIT at 0x5ad925 into the float at record + 0x18, defaulted to 50.0 at 0x5ad805; the slot count the installer reads, (record + 0x210) + 0xc, is filled from CLUSTER_SIZE at 0x4baa17 in a zero-filled object (0 when absent), per slot, and not from AMMO_LIMIT; through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_ammo_declarations the eleven selectable rocket records all declare CLUSTER_SIZE and only wep_12 also declares AMMO_LIMIT (100, stack 2). NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); any reader of the parsed AMMO_LIMIT float (a negative static search found none, which is not proof of absence), so the meaning of its 50.0 default and of 100 / 9999 on ordnance records is unknown; the runtime use of the installed count; the media mapping and equipment-rule census, which stay with the parent task T452-R.03. The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
